flashStructure.scope: Read-only bounded native PXO->FreeKick SWF static structure/resource review; no Flash/native code execution.

structure.validationMethod: Strict bounded recursive tag walk, including every DefineSprite payload: each tag header/payload stays inside its containing range, End has zero length and ends exactly at the enclosing range boundary, and every declared frame count equals direct ShowFrame tags.

languageEvidence.provenEncoding: AVM1 action tags. Source-level ActionScript1 versus2 is not distinguishable from these shared bytecode tags alone.
languageEvidence.flashLiteVersion: Not established by SWF7 header or static structure.

limits: Read-only bounded review: no PXO, ActionScript, native callback, audio or game code was executed.
Tag framing, lengths, End tags and frame counts were statically validated; this is not complete semantic validation of every shape, font or action instruction.
SWF version 7 and AVM1 action tags are proven. Exact Flash Lite runtime version and source-level ActionScript 1 versus 2 are not established by this shared bytecode format.
No standalone game playability, audio decoding/audibility, complete OEM callback support or runtime asset completeness is claimed.
The eleven .wav names carry MMMD/CNTI bytes with exact top-level container lengths; no sound conversion or complete SMAF semantic validation was performed.
Other nine target game modules yielded no exact external-resource filename/path attribution in the bounded decoded ASCII/UTF16 scan. Generic UI/font/private EFS paths were not assigned to games.
flashStructure.offsetConvention: All SWF offsets refer to reconstructed uncompressed FWS bytes, including its 8-byte header; PXO offset refers to independently hash-checked decoded native payload.

mmiAdapterEvidence.interpretation: Static AVM1 operands establish the dynamic .wav filename expression and OEM-style SetVars/startSound bridge request. They do not establish a standard SWF filesystem API or a working host callback.
mmiAdapterEvidence.soundDirectoryPath: Not present as a literal in this SWF. Association is to the eleven same-game sound files by exact unique stems plus the dynamic .wav suffix; the host-side directory resolution was not executed.

selectedDecodedPxoScan.limit: Bounded scanner result, not absence of every unknown encoding or fragmented payload.

legacyKdz.method: Published deterministic file-size-derived key, RC4 to CAB. No vendor binary executed; no key search.

limits: No new SGS was recovered; native PXO is not SGS.
Fourteen modules are not fourteen proven games. Menus, WIPI modules and possible stubs are labelled separately.
Service packages are not full phone flash or user-installed download storage.
Zero scan hits are only a bounded scanner result, not proof that every encoding or fragment is absent.
Native phone application execution, full loader ABI and external-resource completeness are unverified.
No Sinjisoft authorship is inferred from native game filenames or GNEX MIME strings.
Original firmware containers, BIN, vendor DLL, service payloads and private EFS are not bundled.
GPL tools and original data have separate licensing; no rights to LG payloads are granted by GPL or the Reunion MIT licence.
